title: Count Integers With Even Digit Sum
summary: For a given positive integer num, count how many positive integers up to num have an even sum of digits.
statement: For a given positive integer num, count how many positive integers up to num have an even sum of digits.
constraints: Count positive integers x with 1 <= x <= num.
A number qualifies when the sum of its decimal digits is even.
num is at least one and at most one thousand.
hints: Digit-sum parity alternates between neighboring numbers except across carries, but paired counts remain balanced.
Exactly half of 1..num qualify, with the final unpaired endpoint included only when its digit sum is even.
Compute the digit sum of num; return num//2 for even parity and (num-1)//2 otherwise.
Pairing consecutive endpoints yields one even digit-sum member per pair; the parity of num resolves the lone endpoint when needed.
editorial: Pairing consecutive endpoints yields one even digit-sum member per pair; the parity of num resolves the lone endpoint when needed.

tests.explanation: Among 1 through 4, only 2 and 4 have even digit sums, so return 2.
Fourteen positive integers through 30 have an even digit sum.
